sloka: ततो भूमिम् असंस्पृष्ट्वा पुनः आगन्तुम् उत्सहे ।प्रवेगेन एव महता भीमेन प्लवगर्षभाः ॥४-६७-१६॥
transliteration: tato bhūmim asaṁspṛṣṭvā punaḥ āgantum utsahe ।pravegena eva mahatā bhīmena plavagarṣabhāḥ ॥4-67-16॥

translations.english: 'O bull among monkeys when the Sun rises from behind the eastern mountain it is possible for me to start with him and go to the western horizon and return before the blazing Sun with its beams of light sets. It is also possible for me to descend to the earth with the same speed and return to the Sun without touching the earth.
translations.hindi: वेदवेद्ये परे पुंसि जाते दशरथात्मजे । येदः प्राचेतसादासोत्साक्षाद्रामायणात्मना
